pages.text: An $(item)Antenna Switch$() gives one radio three antennas, one at a time. Run the radio's coax into it: the brass input turns to face that coax by itself. The other three sides are outputs 1, 2 and 3, clockwise from the input, each to an antenna's coax.$(br2)Right click to turn the knob to the next output. The radio has only that antenna; the other two are left disconnected.
The splitter's box with a lever for the knob.
